scenario: Slot type that's neither a builtin (Int / Float / String / Bool / Json) nor a schema declared in the same file rejects with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_TYPE per IDAT.5.3 / E6. Pin: a slot declared `parent: NonExistent` rejects because `NonExistent` matches no builtin and no local schema. Cross-file SCHEMA refs (`parent: lib.NonExistent`) aren't part of the v1 grammar (slot type is bare TYPE_NAME without library qualifier), so the same diagnostic surfaces for any unknown type.
